meaning_score_note: Added Codex review after observing that the frozen strict key-term rule rejects understandable share/shared variations; original WER and strict flags are unchanged.
meaning_rule: ASR retains both the shared-folder status request and its reference to missing conceptual-design files; minor word forms/fillers are allowed. This is ASR content, not proof of internal comprehension.
correct_answer_rule: With all listed evidence supplied, state both the reported folder placement and identified components-design PowerPoint without a material unsupported status/action. Score native text and independent speech transcripts separately.
limitations: One question, one greedy replay per prefix, controlled answer start and a 19.2-second response window; this is not the full 105-question benchmark or a universal context limit.
